content: As the surrounding structures grow upward, the olfactory areas are transformed into depressions known as olfactory pits. These pits indent the frontonasal process and divide it into a medial nasal prominence and two lateral nasal prominences (also referred to as lateral nasal processes, nasolateral prominences, or nasal prominences). In pathology, a failure of these structures to fuse properly can result in the development of a cleft lip.
